papers.xml: We targeted the TP53 locus in Homo sapiens (GRCh38) using SpCas9. The guide RNA sequence was GGCGCCATCTACAAGCAGTC. The PAM motif was NGG. Delivery used electroporation into HEK293T (RRID:CVCL_0063). A non-targeting sgRNA was included. Editing was measured by amplicon NGS (n = 3 biological replicates). Off-target analysis used GUIDE-seq. Guides were designed with CRISPOR on strand Watson. Coordinates chr17:7676594-7676613. Variant eSpCas9. Cells were harvested 72 hours after puromycin selection. We isolated single-cell clones. Editing efficiency of 55%. 11 nominated off-target sites were assayed. The plasmid was Addgene 62988. Antibody RRID:AB_331743. Statistics used Student's t-test. Clones were karyotyped. Culture used DMEM with 10% FBS at 37 °C.
